_comment: Seeded once, on first run, only when data/universe/profiles/ is empty.
Editing this file does NOT change profiles that already exist on disk.
up_all is the default every assignment points at, so the day this ships
nothing is enforced anywhere and behaviour is unchanged.
up_liquid_movers reproduces the screen build_universe.py applies today
(price >= 15, adv20 >= 5M, dollar volume >= 50M, ATR% >= 1). Assigning it
to the system setups is what makes widening the base universe safe: every
symbol in today's 243-name universe already passes all four by
construction, so the alert stream is unchanged until the universe grows.
CAVEAT on atr_pct: build_universe.py computes it as mean(high-low)/close,
a simple average range. The atr_pct condition uses SymbolState.atr_d1,
which is a Wilder ATR. They are different numbers for the same symbol, so
a byte-equality proof against the CSV screen must account for it.

profiles.name: All symbols
profiles.desc: No conditions. Every symbol in the base universe passes. This is the default for every setup.

profiles.name: Liquid movers
profiles.desc: The screen build_universe.py applies today, expressed as a profile. Large and mid caps that actually move: enough dollar volume to get filled, enough daily range to pay.

profiles.name: Small cap runners
profiles.desc: The opposite end of the base universe: cheap, low float, moving hard on volume. Unassigned by default. NOTE the float figure comes from yfinance and is stale often enough that it should not be trusted alone.
